payout_value_note: Flat $50 to the referrer and $50 to the referred customer. Referrer capped at 10 rewards ($500) per calendar year.
payout_quote: Refer your friends and family to open a Checking, Savings, or Money Market with us and you will each receive $50*! And, as a loyal Byron Bank customer, you can refer up to 10 friends and/or family per year and earn up to $500*!
steps: Current customer fills out the Refer-A-Friend card and gives it to the friend or family member.
Friend fills out the new-customer section and brings the completed card to account opening.
Friend (not a current Byron Bank checking/savings/money market customer) opens a qualifying account (Aspire, Progressive, Advantage, Dynamic Checking; Smart Savings, Investor Savings, Money Market).
Referrer's bonus credited when the referred customer opens a qualified account; friend's bonus credited after 60 days of account opening.
Bonuses considered interest, reported on IRS Form 1099-INT.
catches: Referrer cap: 10 referral rewards ($500 max) per calendar year.
Physical Refer-A-Friend card is required at account opening to be eligible.
Friend's bonus credited only after 60 days of account opening; if the new account is closed within 6 months, the bonus is forfeited.
Byron Bank employees are not eligible for the cash bonus.
Participants must be 18+; program subject to change/cancellation without notice.
biggest_catch: Capped at $500/year (10 referrals), a physical card is required at account opening, and the friend's bonus can be forfeited if the account closes within 6 months.
eligibility: Byron Bank customers with a checking, savings, or money market account; friend must not be a current Byron customer.
timing: Card handoff ~5 min active; referrer's bonus at account opening, friend's after 60 days.
